Kit summary

Wheat DropActive
Deals DMG equal to 20% of Blaze's Max HP to a single enemy and reduces their Turn Meter by 30%.
Dance of OpulenceActive
Increases all allies' Turn Meters by 10% and grants them [ATK Up II] for 2 turns. Then grants [Ear of Wheat] to the ally with the highest initial ATK for 2 turns (this skill's CD cannot be affected or refreshed). For every stage of Direct DMG dealt by the [Ear of Wheat] ally, Blaze deals DMG equal to 8% of her Max HP with +30% Crit Rate to the same target, up to 6 times per [Ear of Wheat] granted.
Bouquet of Plenty Lv.1Also grants all allies [SPD Up II] for 2 turns and reduces the CD of a random skill of the [Ear of Wheat] ally by 1 turn.
Bumper HarvestPassive
At the start of her turns gains 1 layer of [Petal]. At 4 layers, removes them and grants [Protection of Opulence] to the ally with the highest initial ATK for 2 of that ally's turns (counts as Ally Protection): their DMG taken -40%, with 70% of the reduced DMG shared by Blaze. On granting, cleanses all Control from herself and the ally and grants both a [Shield] equal to 60% of Blaze's Max HP for 2 turns (cannot be removed or stolen).
Bouquet of Plenty Lv.2At the start of each wave, Blaze gains 30% Turn Meter and all allies gain [Crit DMG Up II] for 2 turns.
Fragrance of WheatActive
Deals DMG equal to 15% of Blaze's Max HP to all enemies, with 50% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn. If [Stun] fails, refreshes the duration of all Attribute Debuffs on the target; if Blaze inflicts [Stun] on that target again, it cannot be blocked until successfully inflicted.
Bouquet of Plenty Lv.3Casting it grants all allies [ATK Up II] for 2 turns. At the start of each wave Blaze gains 5 layers of [Vegetate]; gains 1 more when the [Ear of Wheat] ally deals Direct DMG via proactive skills. At 10 layers, removes them and casts Fragrance of Wheat to pursue and attack once. She can gain [Vegetate] again after casting Fragrance of Wheat proactively.
Bouquet of Plenty (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
